children: Crypto podcast host Andy said an AI product or feature for institutional on-chain asset management, with built-in risk strategies, is expected to launch in the coming days. According to ChainCatcher, the product has reportedly been piloted with several funds and asset management firms. Andy previously accurately previewed the launch of the SEC’s crypto exemption policy a week in advance.

title: Andy Says AI Product for Institutional On-Chain Asset Management Is Coming in Days
